scope: bounded unauthenticated public metadata; no order books, registry writes, strategy, or execution

kalshi.category: SERVER_FILTERED on GET /series; league family CLIENT_FILTERED from structured series metadata
kalshi.league: CLIENT_FILTERED from structured series metadata, then child events SERVER_FILTERED by series_ticker
kalshi.event: SERVER_FILTERED by event_ticker on market listing; direct event detail is available
kalshi.date_time: CLIENT_FILTERED for scheduled event date; server close/update bounds are not comparable scheduled-event ordering

polymarket_us.event: CLIENT_FILTERED within bounded league/category results; direct event detail is available

sources.parameters: status=open; with_nested_markets=true; series_ticker=<selected>; limit=200; two pages maximum for sports and one per politics/company series
type=sport|futures; limit=100; two pages maximum per league/type
active=true; closed=false; archived=false; categories=politics|finance; limit=100; orderBy=startTime; orderDirection=asc; two pages maximum

sampling.child_markets: reported for family visibility only; not weighted as independent universe observations

politics_2026.reference_window: 2026 election cycle; Polymarket US exposes 2026-11-03 while sampled Kalshi state/office events expose the 2026 election year and inauguration/sworn-in settlement timestamps

overlap_method.strong_event_overlap: same structured league, exact scheduled local date, and both structured team abbreviations present in the other venue event identity
overlap_method.possible_politics_overlap: same jurisdiction, office, and 2026 election year; exact Kalshi election date unavailable in sampled structured fields
overlap_method.possible_company_overlap: same company and IPO-announcement family; child threshold dates or settlement definitions remain non-identical or unverified

representative_strong_event_overlaps.shared_identity: NFL; Arizona and Los Angeles Chargers

child_family_observation.kalshi: representative NFL and MLB game events each expose two binary team-winner children
child_family_observation.polymarket_us: representative NFL and MLB events expose a structured SPORTS_MARKET_TYPE_MONEYLINE child plus spread and total families
child_family_observation.remaining_verification: resolution, tie, postponement, cancellation, void/fair-market, outcome orientation, and settlement timing require primary-source comparison before VERIFIED status

coverage_limitations: Polymarket US NFL futures exceeded the two-page bound; current game-event pages were complete within the bound.
Polymarket US politics exceeded the two-page bound, so the audit does not estimate all 2026 race overlap.
Kalshi scheduled election dates are not exposed consistently in sampled state/office fields; politics relationships remain POSSIBLE.
Company IPO dates use different month-end/month-start boundaries and full IPO definitions were not compared.
No primary-source contract-rule equivalence review was performed.
coverage_adequacy_reason: The server-filtered MLB and NFL game strata were complete inside the stated bounds and produced 73 exact same-league, same-team, same-scheduled-date event relationships. Incomplete futures and politics pagination limits exhaustive breadth but no longer blocks the existence/overlap judgment.
strategic_scope: observed current MLB/NFL game-event universe; not a statement that any contract pair is equivalent or profitable
interpretation: The prior zero-overlap result was materially caused by non-comparable generic sampling. Current public metadata supports continued Kalshi-Polymarket US discovery, focused next on primary-source contract equivalence for one sports game rather than matcher tuning.
recommended_next_milestone: Manually verify one representative strong NFL or MLB game-winner relationship against both venues' primary contract rules; do not capture books or run strategy until the canonical VERIFIED-pair gate is satisfied.
safety: No credentials, authentication, order books, accounts, balances, positions, fills, registry writes, strategy/paper/live execution, orders, cancels, production execution, or real-money action.
